text: Jules: Flag from design review in-console docs panel uses mixed labels: header says 'Docs', breadcrumb says 'Help', and footer CTA toggles between 'Learn more' and 'Open docs'. Confusing for new users. Screenshot attached. Priya: Agreed. Our guideline: use 'Help' for short in-app surfaces, reserve 'Docs' for the canonical site. So header should be 'Help' and CTA should be 'Open full docs' (explicit external). Marcus: For engineering: we need a stable canonical slug for the crosslink so analytics and support can link to it. Proposal: /docs/console/topic/?source=help-panel. We'll also add a redirect from older /docs/old-slug paths. Wei: Accessibility checklist I ran: - close button missing aria-label (SVG only) - dialog container missing role="dialog" aria-modal="true" - trigger lacks aria-expanded/aria-controls - focus not restored to trigger on keyboard close - link CTA doesn't mention "opens in new tab" for screen readers Hannah: UX idea: show a micro caption under header: 'Quick tips — open full docs for examples (new tab)'. Keeps the panel compact but points people to the site. Include an external icon after CTA. Jules: Also localization spot: localized docs titles may not map 1:1 to 'Help' vs 'Docs' in other languages. Can we add a mapping file so translators see context? Priya: Good call. I'll add a note to the i18n spec: UI label -> glossary term mapping. Marcus: Dev plan: - change header -> 'Help' - footer CTA -> Open full docs \u2197 - add aria-label on close button: aria-label="Close help panel" - ensure role="dialog" and focus trap/restore - emit analytics events: help_panel.view, help_panel.cta_click Wei: Tests: unit test for CTA href includes ?source=help-panel, accessibility e2e for focus restore, and a screenreader assertion that CTA reads 'Open full docs, opens in new tab'. Also add contrast snapshot for dark mode. Hannah: Copy tweak: header -> 'Help', subhead -> 'Quick tips & examples', CTA -> 'Open full docs (new tab)'. Keep CTA sentence-case. Jules: Can we also include a small 'open in console' link on the docs page that points back to the panel when possible? Might help users recontextualize. Use ?openPanel=true param. Priya: We'll add the ?openPanel token to the docs URL for deep-linking if the console detects it; can be follow-up after initial rollout. Marcus: I'll open the PR with the aria and link changes and add the redirect on the docs side. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3451 Wei: I'll add the accessibility tests in the same branch. Branch: feature/help-panel-labels-a11y. Hannah: Small visual nit: CTA color in dark mode fails AA on 14px. I'll attach contrast swatches. Jules: OK team, target next patch. Priya please update the design token and i18n note. Marcus/Wei tag accessibility and docs when you open the PR. Priya: On it. I'll update Figma and the i18n spec now. Marcus: PR opened, linking back once CI passes. Wei: Running axe checks locally, will push tests. Hannah: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a screenshot of the revised panel once merged.
